caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical composition with two large, rectangular designs placed one above the other, separated by a horizontal band. Each rectangular design contains intricate geometric patterns bounded by green outlines, with internal shapes filled in orange, blue, black, and red colors. The top and bottom rectangles both feature vertical and horizontal bars, triangular elements, and repeated lozenge and rectangle segments. In the middle band between the two main rectangles, there is a brown, four-legged animal, resembling a horse or a deer, facing right, and two small circles near its head. The overall background is a pale beige or off-white color, and the drawing seems to use watercolor and ink. There are faint lines and shading, indicating folds or texture on the surface being depicted, and the drawing appears contained within a softly sketched rectangular frame. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature and date in red ink.
title: Parchment Book Cover
